metadata.title: English Crossword Puzzles by CEFR Level
metadata.description: 36 themed crossword puzzles. Themes, word length, word frequency and clue complexity are calibrated to each CEFR level. Answers may contain spaces or hyphens; the grid uses letters only and the clue shows the word lengths.
metadata.framework: CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages)

A1.name: Beginner
